checks.name: registration preserves authored numeric values and actual resource identity
same resource is registered once despite many users
one role update changes two distinct glass resources in place
role changes preserve colour alpha texture UV specular and shader flags
identical tuning is an idempotent no-op
newly registered existing material inherits active numeric role overrides
metallic and roughness clamp to valid unit range
non-numeric nonfinite forbidden and non-light energy inputs are ignored
booleans and infinity cannot masquerade as numeric material properties
unknown role neither registers nor changes material
conflicting semantic ownership of same resource is rejected
custom shaders and null resources are explicitly unsupported
light feature may initialize once at explicit material creation
light runtime tuning clamps energy and never re-enables feature flags
energy zero does not switch the emission shader feature
registering an existing light without creation flag leaves emission disabled
vertical fins and steel aliases share the metal role
source-reviewed colour exceptions classify by substance
ambiguous or custom shader keys do not silently become glass or metal
dynamic OSM roof colours retain separate roof classification
stats exposes actual role counts and isolated override snapshots
registry weak references do not keep released materials alive
unregister detaches future role updates without cloning or clearing material
world reset clears membership and overrides
snapshot restores each material exact original roughness and metallic
restoring an absent profile removes temporary overrides
snapshot restores prior role profile as well as per-material values
materials registered during preview restore authored baseline and prior profile
unknown wrong-role and foreign-registry snapshots fail without mutation
malformed snapshot rejects atomically without changing values or profile
snapshots do not retain released materials and restore skips them
snapshot from before registry clear is rejected
exact-path facade resources register glass and stone without duplication
shader snapshots distinguish unset defaults and explicit default overrides
glass role edits only mapped facade glass uniforms
stone role changes wall roughness without changing facade glass or adding uniforms
shader restore returns null to defaults and explicit originals exactly
independent stone restore clears only its temporary wall override
facade tuning preserves resource identity shader code and authored colour pattern parameters
water shader remains unregistered despite a glass-like material key
duplicate facade registration remains idempotent for both memberships

scope: Bounded StandardMaterial3D and exact-path ShaderMaterial resource tests; no GPU or full city
